_populator_notes: NFC prompts: the 34 items retained in Cacioppo & Petty (1982), JPSP 42(1):116-131, reproduced as published, in the paper's pool order, with reverse_scored per the paper's keying (21 reversed, 13 positive). Transcribed by the project owner from Table 1 of the paper and mapped on #766 (decision 7, 2026-10-12); the mapping and the three typo corrections are recorded in tests/database/test_nfc_fixture_keying.py. The credit is the 'Self-assessment questionnaire items' table in Settings -> About (#195a: notices live there and nowhere else). Decision 2 (owner): the published items are used as-is; the credit names the source and the publisher's copyright and makes no statement about permission either way (owner, 2026-10-12).

NFC response scale: the paper's nine-point scale, -4 'very strong disagreement' to +4 'very strong agreement' (owner, 2026-10-12, decision 9), stored as 1..9 with the paper's nine verbal anchors in agree-ascending order. v1 was finalised with this scale before any administration was taken by a real user, so it is not a new instrument version.

LGO prompts: the 13-item final instrument of VandeWalle (1997), Educational & Psychological Measurement 57(6):995-1015, ADAPTED to the study domain (decision 8, owner approved per item on #766 comment #10553, 2026-10-12): 'at work' -> 'in my studies', 'coworkers' -> 'classmates', 'work assignment' -> 'study task', 'others at work' -> 'others in my program', 'projects' -> 'assignments'. Five items are verbatim. Structure (5 learning + 4 prove + 4 avoid), keying (none reversed) and the six-point scale with the paper's anchors are unchanged. It is an unvalidated adaptation and the About panel says so. Pinned by tests/database/test_lgo_fixture_wording.py.

Importance items and attention checks are original to WIMI and ship as-is (CC BY 4.0). atc_01 sits inside the NFC section and uses its nine-point scale; atc_02 sits inside LGO and uses its six-point scale.
